title: Pull request status on the Ship card, found from the branch through gh
notes: For each card with a branch and no pull request number, gh pr list --head <branch> finds the number and stores it on the card. For each card with a number, poll gh pr view (state, mergeable, checks, review decision) about once a minute and show one glyph on the card: checks running, checks failed, approved, mergeable, merged. A merged pull request is recorded on the card and never polled again. Open: whether a merged pull request moves the card to Done by itself or only marks it.

comments.body: Pull request #266 merged: A card shows its pull request's checks and review as one glyph https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/266
